run_download_models_cli: run the CLI to download pretrained handwriting models to a specified output directory
run_download_discrete_gestures: run the CLI to download pretrained discrete gestures models to a specified output directory
run_download_wrist_models: run the CLI to download pretrained wrist models to a specified output directory
call_download_models_function: call download_models to download and extract a pretrained model tar for a given task
review_download_models_function: review the download_models function to understand how it downloads and extracts model tar files
